title: Rory and the Starry Meadow
verses:
The stars started winking above the deep glade,
As Psittaco chirped from a nest in the trees.
The shadows grew long in a soft violet shade,
And flowers were stirred by a lullaby breeze.

High up in the twilight, sweet Nia soared down,
To guide gentle Rory along the cool stream.
They walked past the hill with its velvety crown,
Where blossoms had closed in a slumbering dream.

Calm Tilly stepped softly through carpets of moss,
While Benny walked slow with a comforting tread.
A quiet blue river rolled gently across,
To cradle the bank where they wanted to bed.

Brave Ricky laid down with his chin on his paw,
His heavy plates glowing with warm amber light.
He smiled at the restful dark canyon he saw,
And watched as the stars lit the dome of the night.

Small Psittaco tucked in a leafy green nest,
As Nia swooped down with a flutter of grace.
Each dinosaur knew it was time for their rest,
Wrapped up in the warmth of the meadow's embrace.

Big Rory yawned wide as he closed his bright eyes,
And let out a breath that was cozy and deep.
Beneath the soft glow of the starlit night skies,
The dinosaur friends floated off into sleep.
